milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cut sandstone temple front wall is at spawn-relative (0, 2, 5). With max_distance=5, the player must walk forward from spawn (~5.39 blocks away) to get within range. This prevents trivial satisfaction at spawn (where distance exceeds 5) while still being achievable with 1-2 steps forward. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the temple wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The tripwire string is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 10), stretched between two tripwire hooks on interior cut sandstone pillars. With max_distance=5, the player must enter the temple through the doorway at z=5 and walk to the interior (z≈10) to get within range. From spawn the distance is ~10.05 blocks, so the player must navigate ~6 blocks forward through the temple. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the tripwire trap area.
